cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our bookshop failed here. We're meant to find readers somewhere else. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then we're meant to start smaller. One shelf, properly chosen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could get us a market stall beside the bus stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People waiting with nothing to read! I'll pack the short stories. We've been making our customers come too far.

mechanism: A directs a new bookselling attempt, scales it down around B limits and treats each change as evidence of finding the intended readers.
confusable: Unlike mere business troubleshooting, A converts failure into a reason the desired success belongs elsewhere; cooperation shapes the route.
comparison: A partner offers market access after financial failure, unlike a couple finding a wedding setting around parents availability.
seedUse: D116-b no moving money, one shelf and bus-stop stall; S02-b adapts method while keeping B engaged in the plan.
